Guides / Progress & money / Bounties

Bounties

The shared bounty board: every bounty, its tickets and requirements.

A new board every 3 UTC days with 4 bounties, the same for every trainer (always at least one a new player can do). Finish them for Bounty Tickets; the easiest ones also hand out a Halloween costume as a guaranteed encounter.

BountyTicketsNeeds
Catch 2 Shiny Pokémon of the board's type25Anyone
Catch 2 Void Pokémon25Anyone
Catch a Pokémon with perfect IVs15Anyone
Register 12 new species15Anyone
Hatch 20 eggs15Anyone
Beat 4 bosses with the board's trait (Iron Shell, Fury or Enrage)152 badges
Make 5 Wonder Trades102 badges
Battle 40 Mass Outbreak Pokémon153 badges
Catch a Shiny, Void or Prismatic Mass Outbreak Pokémon203 badges
Deal 6,000 raid damage points205 badges
Clear a raid as the top damage dealer (with a friend in it)305 badges
Catch 3 Legendary Pokémon205 badges
Reach floor 20, 30 or 40 in a Tower run303 badges

Tickets buy Style items and Game Corner capsules.
